description: Change a growth play's state: start it (in_progress), park it for later (snoozed, with days), skip it for good (skipped, with a reason), reopen it (open) or finish it (done). Mirrors the To do / In progress / Done / Parked board in the app.

reason.description: Why it was parked or skipped — the best signal for the next plan.

snooze_days.description: Days to park it when snoozed. Defaults to 7.

name: update_play_status
title: Move a play on the board
